([[AG162]]-[[AG187]]) |java=[[Mitsuki Saiga]] }} '''Drew''' (Japanese: '''シュウ''' ''Shū'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] from [[LaRousse City]] and {{an|May}}'s main [[rival]]. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|RS}}==== Drew debuted in ''[[AG033|Now That's Flower Power!]]'', where he was seen watching {{an|May}} {{pkmn|training}} for the [[Slateport City]] [[Pokémon Contest]]. He said she needed a lot of practice and insulted her Pokémon, which made her angry. Later, when May and her friends were looking for [[Bluk Berry|Bluk Berries]], he appeared and challenged her to a {{pkmn|battle}}. He did a good job showing off the [[Move|attacks]] of his {{TP|Drew|Roselia}}, but the battle was interrupted when {{TRT}} stole the Bluk Berries. He then helped May to retrieve the {{Berries}} and left. In ''[[AG035|Win, Lose or Drew!]]'', Drew competed in the Slateport Contest. He received a good score in the [[Appeal|Appeals Round]] and qualified for the [[Contest Battle|second round]], where he and his Roselia defeated May and her {{TP|May|Beautifly}}, but lost to {{ho|Robert}} and his {{p|Milotic}} in the semifinals. [[File:Drew and May.png|thumb|left|220px|Drew and May]] In ''[[AG050|Pros and Con Artists]]'', Drew had a battle with {{Ash}}. Using his Roselia, he was able to defeat [[Ash's Taillow]], despite being at a disadvantage. It was revealed in this episode that he had already won three [[Ribbon]]s. In ''[[AG051|Come What May!]]'', he competed in the {{to|Fallarbor}} Contest; however, he lost to {{ho|Grace}} and her {{p|Medicham}}. Following May's victory, Drew congratulated her by giving her a rose. This gesture was repeated in many other episodes. In ''[[AG061|Disaster of Disguise]]'', Drew had a battle with [[Timmy Grimm|The Phantom]] and lost. He was planning to compete in the {{to|Verdanturf}} Contest, but after his Roselia had gotten injured in the battle with The Phantom's {{p|Dusclops}}, he thought it would not be good enough to battle and decided not to participate. He was seen in the audience in ''[[AG062|Disguise Da Limit]]''. In ''[[AG077|A Fan with a Plan]]'', Drew was revealed to own a {{p|Masquerain}}. He was seen practicing with it, and, in ''[[AG078|Cruisin' for a Losin']]'', he used it to defeat [[Savannah]]'s {{p|Lairon}} in the finals of the [[Rank (Contest)|R1]] [[Rubello Town]] Pokémon Contest. This victory gave Drew his fourth Ribbon. In ''[[AG113|Who, What, When, Where, Wynaut?]]'', it was revealed that Drew had obtained his fifth Ribbon. When May showed him her four Ribbons, he told her that there was only one more Pokémon Contest to be held before the [[Grand Festival]], and criticized her for relying on luck and for not having strategies. May then challenged him to a battle, which was interrupted by Team Rocket's attempt to steal {{AP|Pikachu}}. Accidentally, Drew was pulled into Team Rocket's submarine along with the rest of {{ashfr|the group}}. When the submarine exploded, the entire group was blasted into the air. They fell upon {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}}, where they met a group of {{p|Wynaut}}. Drew entered the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]] in ''[[AG121|Hi Ho Silver Wind!]]'', where he sent out his Roselia to perform in the preliminary Appeals Round. He received an excellent score that allowed him to pass on to the next stage. In ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]'', he used his Masquerain for the main Appeals Round, and the performance given by the {{pkmn|category|Eyeball Pokémon}} moved him on to the Battle Round. In ''[[AG123|Rhapsody in Drew]]'', he faced May in the quarterfinals of the competition. Using his Roselia and {{p|Flygon}}, he was able to defeat May, who was using her {{TP|May|Combusken}} and {{TP|May|Skitty}}. He made it all the way to the finals, where he battled against Robert for the title of [[Top Coordinator]]. However, just like in the Slateport Contest, Drew ended up losing to him. [[File:Drew winning.png|thumb|220px|Drew celebrating a victory]] Afterwards, Drew decided to go to [[Kanto]] to compete in Pokémon Contests there. In ''[[AG139|On Cloud Arcanine]]'', he was seen trying to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} an {{p|Arcanine}} that May was also interested in catching. Both gave up catching the Pokémon when they discovered that it had a litter of {{p|Growlithe}} puppies to take care of. It was also revealed in this episode that he had obtained his first Kanto Ribbon. In ''[[AG162|Spontaneous Combusken!]]'', when May said she was ready to defeat him in the {{isl|Chrysanthemum}} Contest, Drew revealed that he wasn't going to compete because he had participated in several Pokémon Contests lately and his Pokémon were exhausted and in need of some rest and relaxation. In ''[[AG174|New Plot, Odd Lot!]]'' and ''[[AG175|Going for Choke!]]'', Drew watched May competing for her fifth and final Ribbon in the [[Mulberry City]] Pokémon Contest. He also helped Ash to frustrate [[Harley]]'s plans of sabotaging May. Drew reappeared to compete in the [[Kanto Grand Festival]] in ''[[AG180|May, We Harley Drew'd Ya!]]'', where he was reunited with his old friend and [[rival]] [[Solidad]], who had defeated him in his very first Pokémon Contest a long time ago. He managed to pass the Appeals Round and quickly reached the quarterfinals, where he found himself against May once again. He fought a hard battle, but his Flygon and {{p|Absol}} ended up being defeated by May's Combusken and {{TP|May|Squirtle}}. In ''[[AG187|The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing!]]'', after finding May feeling down, he decided to have a Contest Battle with her to cheer her up, which he ended up winning. At the end of the episode, he revealed that he would be traveling to the [[Johto]] [[region]] to participate in Pokémon Contests there. ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== In ''[[DP076|A Full Course Tag Battle!]]'', it was revealed in a flashback that Drew's Roselia had [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{TP|Drew|Roserade}}. May also revealed that Drew was still a major adversary during her journey in Johto. Drew made cameo appearances with Harley and Solidad in ''[[DP077|Staging a Heroes' Welcome!]]'' and ''[[DP079|Strategy with a Smile!]]'', where they were at [[Ecruteak City]], watching May live on [[Television|TV]] as she competed in the [[Wallace Cup]]. [[File:Hoenn Rivals.png|250px|thumb|Drew in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'']] ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== In ''[[JN118|Battling as Hard as Stone!]]'', Drew appeared alongside Harley and [[Professor Birch]], watching {{an|Steven Stone|Steven}}'s [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match against Ash on [[television]]. ===Character=== [[File:Drew grooming Masquerain.png|thumb|left|220px|Drew grooming his Pokémon]] Like {{Gary}}, Drew is portrayed as being confident, critical, and popular among his supporters, though he is generally not as overly insulting or excessively extravagant as Gary initially was. When Drew competed in his very first [[Pokémon Contest]], he lost badly to a strong [[Pokémon Coordinator]] named [[Solidad]]. Solidad said the loss was so heartbreaking that he cried. Though he had suffered a defeat in his debut, he endeavored to become a better Coordinator and has succeeded to a great extent. Since then, he has kept in touch with Solidad and the two developed a friendship. He feels comfortable talking about other Coordinators with her, but he never discusses his own performances. Drew was very prone to nervousness when he started his [[Pokémon journey]], much like May when he first met her. He used to taunt her and belittle {{cat|May's Pokémon|her Pokémon}} and her skills as a Coordinator. Even though his comments and attitude have angered May, he still provides a helping hand whenever she needs it. He also congratulates May when credit is due, occasionally giving her a rose. Drew raises his Pokémon so that they are able to showcase their maximum potential in Pokémon Contests. He is shown to {{pkmn|groomer|groom}} them and treat them well, praising them for their efforts even when they do not succeed. However, when he feels that his Pokémon are not giving it their all, he will scold them. This was shown in ''[[AG181|Thinning the Hoard!]]'' when he became angry at {{p|Absol}} for what he considered to be a lackluster performance. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Drew's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Drew |pkmn=Roserade |stage1=Roselia |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Drew Roserade.png |epnum=AG033 |epname=Now That's Flower Power! |vajp=Ikue Ohtani |vajpnote=Roselia |vaen=Sarah Natochenny |vaennote=Roselia |desc={{p|Roserade}} is Drew's main Pokémon. It first appeared as a {{p|Roselia}} in ''[[AG033|Now That's Flower Power!]]''. As revealed in ''[[DP076|A Full Course Tag Battle!]]'', it evolved into Roserade while accompanying Drew in [[Johto]].}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Drew |pkmn=Masquerain |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |img=Drew Masquerain.png |epnum=AG077 |epname=A Fan with a Plan |vajp=Tomoe Hanba |vaen=Rachael Lillis |vaennote=[[AG077]]-[[AG123]] |vaen2=Michele Knotz |vaen2note=[[AG180]]-[[AG181]] |desc={{p|Masquerain}} debuted in ''[[AG077|A Fan with a Plan]]''. {{an|May}}, while {{pkmn|training}} with her {{TP|May|Bulbasaur}}, stumbled across Drew training his Pokémon's Bubble attack. In the [[AG078|next episode]], he used it in the [[Rubello Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]]. In the first round, it used Ice Beam to freeze its own Bubbles, and then Hidden Power to launch the projectiles at [[Sonny]]'s {{p|Girafarig}} to knock it out. It then managed to outscore [[Savannah]]'s {{p|Lairon}} by hitting it with Hidden Power in the finals to win the Contest. In ''[[AG113|Who, What, When, Where, Wynaut?]]'', Drew used Masquerain again to battle against [[May's Beautifly]], but they were interrupted by {{TRT}} who tried to capture their Pokémon. At the end of the episode, Drew used Masquerain alongside {{TP|Drew|Roselia}} to battle against Team Rocket together with {{an|May}} and {{Ash}}'s Pokémon. It combined a {{m|Silver Wind}} alongside May's Beautifly's to blow them away. It reappeared in the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]]'s [[Appeal|Appeals]] stage in ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]''. Its Bubble and Silver Wind impressed the crowd, scored a perfect 100, and allowed Drew to move on to the final stages of the Contest. In [[AG123|the next episode]], it fought {{ho|Robert}}'s {{p|Claydol}} and {{p|Milotic}} alongside {{p|Flygon}}, but it fell to Claydol's {{m|Hyper Beam}}. In ''[[AG180|May, We Harley Drew'd Ya!]]'', Drew used it in the preliminaries of the [[Kanto Grand Festival]]. It got Drew through to the next round by spinning around and around to create a great gust of wind and air. In ''[[AG181|Thinning the Hoard]]'', it fought alongside Roselia and used Silver Wind alongside Roselia's {{m|Petal Dance}} to defeat a {{p|Medicham}} and a {{p|Loudred}}. Masquerain's known moves are {{m|Bubble}}, {{m|Quick Attack}}, {{m|Hidden Power}}, {{m|Ice Beam}}, and {{m|Silver Wind}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Drew |pkmn=Flygon |type1=Ground |type2=Dragon |img=Drew Flygon.png |epnum=AG123 |epname=Rhapsody in Drew |vajp=Shin-ichiro Miki |vaen=Shin-ichiro Miki |desc={{p|Flygon}} debuted in the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]], it was sent out alongside {{TP|Drew|Roselia}} to battle [[May's Combusken]] and {{TP|May|Skitty}}, where it was able to defeat them. {{an|May}} was surprised to see it, and Drew revealed that he {{pkmn2|caught}} it specifically for the Grand Festival. In ''[[AG139|On Cloud Arcanine]]'', it was used to try to capture an {{p|Arcanine}} and battled [[May's Squirtle]], where it won easily. In ''[[AG175|Going for Choke!]]'', Drew used it to save {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} from {{TRT}}'s traps. Beginning in ''[[AG181|Thinning the Hoard]]'', Drew used it in the [[Kanto Grand Festival]], along with Absol, where it battled May's Combusken and Squirtle. Flygon ended up losing to Squirtle after a tough battle, despite using a combination of its and Drew's Absol's [[move]]s, dubbed ''Dragon Razor Wind'' by [[Lilian Meridian|Lilian]]. Flygon's known moves are {{m|Dragon Breath}}, {{m|Flamethrower}}, {{m|Sandstorm}}, and {{m|Steel Wing}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Drew |pkmn=Absol |type1=Dark |img=Drew Absol.png |epnum=AG180 |epname=May, We Harley Drew'd Ya! |vajp=Megumi Hayashibara |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Absol}} debuted in the [[Kanto Grand Festival]], where Drew used it in his [[Appeal|Appeals]] Round. Even though Absol made it through to the next round with its [[move]] combinations, Drew felt it was not as dedicated to him, unlike his other Pokémon, since it was afraid to attack him with {{m|Razor Wind}} as part of their performance. After a talk with {{Ash}} later that night, Drew decided to use Absol in the Contest alongside his {{p|Flygon}} in the [[Double Battle]] round. Later, they were to fight {{an|May}} and her {{TP|May|Combusken}} and {{TP|May|Squirtle}}. During the battle, Absol was able to use a combination of Drew's Flygon's and its moves, dubbed ''Dragon Razor Wind'' by [[Lilian Meridian|Lilian]]. After a harsh battle, Absol and Combusken were left to fight alone. However, Combusken, after making full use of its newly-learned {{m|Overheat}}, had more points than Absol when the time ran out and May moved on to the semifinals. Absol's known moves are {{m|Flash}}, {{m|Iron Tail}}, {{m|Razor Wind}}, and {{m|Water Pulse}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Drew |pkmn=Butterfree |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |img=Drew Butterfree.png |epnum=AG187 |epname=The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing |vajp=Tomoe Hanba |vaen=Tomoe Hanba |desc=Even though it was only recently {{pkmn2|caught}}, {{p|Butterfree}} was shown to be already very powerful. It was used in a [[Double Battle]] alongside {{TP|Drew|Roselia}} against [[May's Combusken]] and {{TP|May|Beautifly}} where it managed to defeat them after using a combo of Psybeam and {{m|Solar Beam}} from Roselia. Butterfree's known moves are {{m|Confusion}}, {{m|Gust}}, {{m|Psybeam}}, and {{m|Protect}}.}} ===Contests=== [[File:Drew Hoenn Ribbons.png|thumb|200px|Drew's Hoenn Ribbons]] [[File:Drew ribbon AG139.png|thumb|200px|One of Drew's Kanto Ribbons]] ====Hoenn Ribbons==== This listing is of the [[Ribbon]]s Drew has obtained in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]]: * Three unknown Ribbons (prior to ''[[AG050|Pros and Con Artists]]'') * {{to|Rubello}} Ribbon (''[[AG078|Cruisin' for a Losin']]'') * Unknown Ribbon (prior to ''[[AG113|Who, What, When, Where, Wynaut?]]'') ====Kanto Ribbons==== This listing is of the [[Ribbon]]s Drew has obtained in the [[Kanto]] [[region]]: * Unknown Ribbon (prior to ''[[AG139|On Cloud Arcanine]]'') * Four unknown Ribbons (prior to ''[[AG174|New Plot, Odd Lot!]]'') ====Grand Festival ranking==== Drew has competed in the following [[Grand Festival]] tournaments: * [[Hoenn Grand Festival]] - Runner-Up (''[[AG123|Rhapsody in Drew]]'') * [[Kanto Grand Festival]] - Top 8 (''[[AG182|Channeling the Battle Zone!]]'') ====Other achievements==== Drew has competed in the following [[Pokémon Contest]]s: * {{ci|Slateport}} Contest - Top 4 (''[[AG035|Win, Lose or Drew!]]'') * {{to|Fallarbor}} Contest - Top 4 (''[[AG051|Come What May!]]'') ===Voice actors=== {{vatable | color = {{grass color}} | bordercolor = {{grass color light}} | de = Max Felder | ja = 斎賀みつき ''[[Mitsuki Saiga]]'' | ar = نبيل عساف ''Nabil Assaf'' | en = [[Pete Zarustica]] ([[AG033]]-[[AG139]])

Álvaro Navarro ([[AG162]]-present) | ru = Прохор Чеховской ''Prokhor Chekhovskoy'' }} ==In the manga== [[File:Drew AP.png|thumb|180px|Drew in the ''[[Ash & Pikachu]]'' manga]] ===Ash & Pikachu=== ====History==== Drew has a role in [[Ash & Pikachu]]. He appeared in ''[[SP21|The Enchanting Pokémon Soul!]]'', in which he insulted {{an|May}} while she was training her {{TP|May|Beautifly}}. He claimed that May wasn't good in [[Pokémon Contest]] and this made May frustrated. However, Drew did not seem to care. In the {{ci|Slateport}} Contest, Drew sent out {{TP|Drew|Roselia}} and the performance it delivered gave Drew a fantastic score, higher than May's. During the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]], Drew was matched up against May. Despite May trying her best and her Beautifly having the type advantage, Drew was able to defeat her. He went to challenge {{ho|Robert}} and his {{p|Milotic}}, and lost despite the type advantage. After the loss, Drew shrugged it off and promised to be better in the next Pokémon Contest and went off, motivating May to do the same. ====Character==== Unlike his animated series counterpart, he is more flamboyant and arrogant. He also has a tendency to break into dance regularly. Drew was renamed Joel in [[Chuang Yi]]'s English translation. ====Pokémon==== {| width="25%" | {{InactivePoké|Drew|Roselia|Drew Roselia AP.png|Grass|Poison|link=Drew's Roserade#Ash & Pikachu}} |} {{-}} ==Trivia== * Except for his {{p|Masquerain}}, all of Drew's {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} have the same name in English as in Japanese. * Drew is the first character to be a [[Rival|rival]] to one of {{ashfr|Ash's friends}}. ** He is also the first rival of one of Ash's friends to defeat {{Ash}} in a battle. * Drew is the only regular character to be from a {{pkmn|movie}}-exclusive location. * Drew has two Pokémon, Masquerain and {{TP|Drew|Roserade}}, whose names are derived from "masquerade". * The box that Drew keeps his [[Kanto]] [[Ribbon]]s in is modeled after the tail of a {{p|Flygon}}, one of his Pokémon. ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="float:left; background: #{{grass color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{grass color}}" !
